text:
anya: quick new-hire docs question — i'm drafting a 'service handoff' checklist for infra. where are the canonical onboarding templates? and who owns them?

devex-marta: welcome Anya! templates are split: short onboarding flows live under `/Company Templates/Onboarding` and team-runbooks/templates live under `/Templates/engineering`. canonical path for engineering templates: https://redwood.notion.so/templates-engineering

bryan-docs: echoing Marta. If you want to add a new template, please do NOT edit the existing template page in place. Instead: 1) create your draft in My Pages, 2) open a docs-maintainers request (instructions below), 3) maintainers will review and publish to `/Templates/engineering` with the Template metadata filled.

anya: how do i file the maintainers request? is there a ticket queue?

devex-marta: yes — we use the doc-bot queue. From Slack: `@doc-bot new-template-request <notion-link> brief-summary` or click the "Request template review" button in the Notion template page. The bot will create a card on the docs-maintainers board and notify the owners.

anya: neat. who are the owners for eng templates?

bryan-docs: owners are listed as a page property on each template (Template Owner). current owners: `infra-docs-maintainers@redwood.com` and `devex` for onboarding flow. If you want individual review, tag `@devex-marta` and `@bryan-docs`.

anya: naming conv? i'm thinking "service-handoff-checklist" vs something with date

devex-marta: prefer the pattern: `eng-infra - service handoff - YYYY-MM` for the human title, and include frontmatter properties: `Status: Proposal`, `Owner: your-team`, `Template Owner: infra-docs-maintainers`. For file-level discoverability also add a property `Tags: onboarding, handoff`.

anya: will moving from My Pages to the Templates location break templates or the template button?

bryan-docs: yes you should NOT move a live Template button page around. Best practice: create a normal page draft, once approved the maintainers will create a Template in the `/Templates/engineering` space that points to the approved draft content. That keeps the Template button intact and avoids broken references.

anya: can i request edit access to the /Templates/engineering space to iterate faster?

doc-bot: Access request instructions: run `@doc-bot request-access /Templates/engineering` or open a ticket at https://redwood.internal/requests/docs-access. Access is granted to maintain edit hygiene; reviewers will add Editor for 7 days for iterative edits.

devex-marta: note for new hires: use the onboarding checklist in `/Company Templates/Onboarding/New Hire Checklist`. It contains the Notion setup step (initialize My Pages, join Team Docs) and the docs linking conventions.

anya: thanks! i'll draft in My Pages and ping `@devex-marta` and `@bryan-docs` when it's ready for review. also adding a TODO to include a short step for retiring old WIP templates.

bryan-docs: perfect. when you ping, include the desired template title and a 1-2 line description. we'll run a quick litmus (links resolve, page properties set) before publishing. :raised_hands:

doc-bot: Action logged: new-template-request created by anya for https://redwood.notion.so/your-draft-page. ticket: DOCS-412 (assigned to infra-docs-maintainers)

anya: awesome, thanks everyone :sparkles:
